arabic text: WAKT SAJJAD NE KAISE WO GUZAARA HONGA\nNAAM ZAINAB KA JO GAIRO NE PUKAARAHOGA
english translation text: How must Sajjad have endured that time,\nwhen strangers called out Zainab’s name?

arabic text: YA RAB KOI MIL JAYE NA PEHCHAANNEWALA\nBAZAAR NE SAJJAD DUA MANG RAHA HAI
english translation text: O Lord, may no one here recognise us—\nthis was Sajjad’s prayer in the marketplace.

arabic text: LO HUSSAIN IBNE ALI PYAASE ZIBHA HONE LAGE\nKITNA SHARMINDA WHO DARYA KA KANARA HOGA
english translation text: Look—Hussain, son of Ali, is being slaughtered while thirsty;\nhow ashamed the riverbank must have been.

arabic text: WO GIRA ZINSE ZAINAB KI RIDA KA ZAMIN\nKON AB FATEMA JAYI KA SAHARA HOGA
english translation text: The ground upon which Zainab’s veil fell—\nwho now would support the daughter of Fatima?

arabic text: SARE MAIDAN TO JANE TO LAGA HAI ASGAR\nKIS TARAH TERE BINA MAA KA GUZAARA HOGA
english translation text: O Asghar, you are about to leave for the battlefield;\nhow will your mother survive without you?

arabic text: NAUKE NEZA PE BAHANE LAGE ANSOO MAULA\nFIR SAKINA KO KISI SHAKS NE MARA HOGA
english translation text: The Master began shedding tears from atop the spear;\nperhaps someone had struck Sakina again.

arabic text: ROZE MEHSHAR KA HAME DAR NAHI KOI SHAUKAT\nHATH SHABBIR KE KADMO PE HAMARA HOGA
english translation text: O Shaukat, we have no fear of the Day of Judgement;\nour hands will be at Shabbir’s feet.
